text:
## PEP Screening  
**Definition:** PEP = Politically Exposed Person (government official, senior politician, military leader, etc.)  
**Screening Requirements:**
- Screen all new customers against PEP databases
- Screen immediate family of PEP
- Screen close associates of PEP
- Ongoing monitoring for PEP status changes  
**PEP Database Sources:**
- FCA/PRA PEP lists
- Sanctions list cross-references
- Third-party data providers  
**Action if PEP Identified:**
1. Flag customer in system as PEP
2. Enhanced due diligence mandatory
3. Escalate to Compliance Head
4. Enhanced ongoing monitoring
5. Consider transaction restrictions

raw_entities.name: PEP Screening Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the identification, screening, and ongoing monitoring of Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and their family members and close associates. Establishes mandatory screening requirements at customer onboarding and continuous monitoring obligations, with escalation and enhanced due diligence procedures upon PEP identification.
context: PEP = Politically Exposed Person (government official, senior politician, military leader, etc.)
Screen all new customers against PEP databases
Ongoing monitoring for PEP status changes

raw_entities.name: Politically Exposed Person Risk
raw_entities.description: The financial crime risk posed by customers who are government officials, senior politicians, military leaders, or their immediate family members and close associates. This category encompasses the heightened risk of money laundering, corruption, and sanctions violations associated with PEP relationships.
context: PEP = Politically Exposed Person (government official, senior politician, military leader, etc.)

raw_entities.name: Mandatory PEP Screening at Customer Onboarding
raw_entities.description: Requirement to screen all new customers against PEP databases prior to account opening. This is a foundational control to identify high-risk customers at the point of relationship initiation.
context: Screen all new customers against PEP databases

raw_entities.name: PEP Family and Associate Screening
raw_entities.description: Requirement to screen not only direct PEPs but also their immediate family members and close associates against PEP databases. Extends the scope of PEP identification beyond the primary customer.

raw_entities.name: Ongoing PEP Status Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Requirement to continuously monitor existing customers for changes in PEP status throughout the customer lifecycle. Ensures that customers who acquire PEP status after account opening are identified and escalated.
context: Ongoing monitoring for PEP status changes

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence for Identified PEPs
raw_entities.description: Requirement to conduct enhanced due diligence on any customer identified as a PEP. This mandatory escalation ensures deeper investigation of the customer's background, source of funds, and business purpose.

raw_entities.name: PEP Escalation to Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: Requirement to escalate any PEP identification to the Compliance Head for review and decision-making. Ensures senior management oversight of high-risk customer relationships.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Ongoing Monitoring for PEPs
raw_entities.description: Requirement to apply enhanced ongoing monitoring to customers identified as PEPs. This elevated monitoring standard applies throughout the customer relationship to detect suspicious activity.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Restrictions for PEPs
raw_entities.description: Provision allowing for the consideration and implementation of transaction restrictions on PEP customers. Provides discretionary authority to limit or block certain transaction types based on risk assessment.

raw_entities.name: PEP Database Screening
raw_entities.description: Operational control mechanism for screening customers against PEP databases. Utilizes multiple data sources including FCA/PRA lists, sanctions cross-references, and third-party providers to identify PEP status.
context: Screen all new customers against PEP databases

raw_entities.name: PEP System Flagging
raw_entities.description: Control requiring that customers identified as PEPs be flagged in the bank's system. This flag serves as a persistent marker to alert staff and trigger enhanced procedures throughout the customer lifecycle.
context: Flag customer in system as PEP

raw_entities.name: PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: Anti-Money Laundering screening process for identifying Politically Exposed Persons and their family members and close associates. Includes initial screening at customer onboarding and ongoing monitoring throughout the customer relationship.
context: Screen all new customers against PEP databases
Ongoing monitoring for PEP status changes

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: Senior compliance role responsible for receiving escalations of PEP identifications and making decisions regarding enhanced due diligence, ongoing monitoring, and transaction restrictions. Acts as the decision-making authority for high-risk PEP customer cases.

raw_entities.name: FCA/PRA PEP Lists
raw_entities.description: Official PEP databases maintained by the Financial Conduct Authority and Prudential Regulation Authority. These lists serve as primary sources for screening customers against known Politically Exposed Persons.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions List Cross-References
raw_entities.description: Regulatory sanctions lists used in conjunction with PEP screening to identify customers with sanctions exposure. Cross-referenced as part of the comprehensive PEP screening process.

raw_entities.description: Customers applying for or opening new accounts with the bank. Subject to mandatory PEP screening as part of the customer onboarding process.
context: Screen all new customers against PEP databases
